label: CD74::ROS1

sections.text: CD74 encodes the invariant chain required for major histocompatibility complex class II processing.
ROS1 encodes a receptor tyrosine kinase involved in growth and survival signaling.
The fusion retains the ROS1 kinase domain and replaces its amino-terminal regulatory region, generating an activating kinase driver documented in lung adenocarcinoma.

ROS1-positive locally advanced or metastatic NSCLC is a US-approved indication for repotrectinib and taletrectinib in adults. These indications cover ROS1-positive NSCLC rather than a particular partner.
